There is NO county Schedule A page anywhere in the 11-page PDF - the filer's own 6-page sheet simply IS Schedule A ('attachment-is-the-schedule'). The county Schedule B page IS present (p9) with 'See attached.' written across the first data row and its SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells blank ('attachment-behind-stub'). Every page was rendered and looked at before classifying. ROTATION: both attachments are stored rotated 90 degrees inside the PDF; poppler renders them as portrait pages whose text reads bottom-to-top. All six Schedule-A pages and both Schedule-B pages sit at the SAME rotation - checked page by page, no mixed-rotation seam. Geometry is emitted in the portrait frame poppler renders, so each row's box is a NARROW VERTICAL STRIP: x/w = the row's position across the page, y/h = the full height of the table (Amount at the top of the portrait page through Date Received at the bottom). x/w come from detected rules; y/h from detected column rules. OCCUPATION: the attachment's own column header reads 'Employer/Occupation' - note the order is REVERSED from the county form's own 'Occupation/Employer' column. It is ONE combined column, not two, so its verbatim content goes into `occupation` and no `employer` key is used. Only 3 of 172 rows carry any content: p3 row 1 'OE Local 3 District 12', p6 row 16 'Gardner Company/CEO', p7 row 9 'Attorney/Parsons Behle & Latimer'. The other 169 cells: the column EXISTS and the filer left them empty (said per row in the row note). PRIVACY: the Schedule-A attachment does print an 'Address' column and the county's black bar covers it end to end on every one of pp.3-8 - verified at 300 dpi that no text survives outside the bar. All donor_city/donor_state are blank with 'redacted at source' in the row note - NOT 'left empty by the filer'. The Schedule-B attachment has no address column at all. DOCUMENT vs CHUNK FILE: the form AGREES with the chunk file on candidate (Shireen Ghorbani), office (Salt Lake County Council At-large A - the form's own Office and Office Sought lines both read this), report type (Year-End, January 31 box checked) and cycle. Two internal date facts kept verbatim: the cover's Report Verification signature date is 1/31/20 while every attachment page and the Summary Page header print 'Date of Report 1/30/20' - one day apart, neither corrected. The clerk's RECEIVED stamp reads JAN 31 2020. OTHER SOURCE PROPERTIES: expenditure rows are not in strict date order on p10 (a 07/01/19 and a second 07/01/19 row follow a 07/19/19 row); printed order retained. The filer misspells 'processing' as 'processsing' throughout the Schedule-B purpose column; kept verbatim. No in-kind marker appears anywhere on either attachment and neither has an in-kind column. Cover street address, phone, fax and email are all under the county's bar; nothing of that kind was read or recorded.

contributions.detail: 172 rows over attachment pp.3-8 sum to 11,794.00 = the attachment's own printed grand total on p8 ($11,794) = Summary Page line 1 Column A ($11,794.00) = line 1 Column B. Both printed anchors have the SAME scope here (the filing is a year-end covering the whole 2019 cycle and Column A = Column B on every line), so there is no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap and no in-kind exclusion to test - no row on this attachment carries any in-kind marker, and the attachment has no in-kind column.

expenditures.detail: 47 rows over attachment pp.10-11 sum to 4,015.20 = the attachment's own printed grand total on p11 ($4,015.20) = Summary Page line 2 Column A = line 2 Column B. The county Schedule B page (p9) prints its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells BLANK, so the county form supplies no gate of its own.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' is printed anywhere on either filer attachment, and the one county schedule page present (p9, Schedule B) has both its SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells blank - so the page-subtotal gate is NOT AVAILABLE on this filing. Gate used instead: each attachment's own printed grand total on its last page (p8 $11,794 for A; p11 $4,015.20 for B), each of which equals its Summary Page Column-A figure. Both close EXACTLY.
itemized.escalation_note: All escalations are tight column crops at 400-600 dpi, PIL-rotated 90 degrees clockwise to upright before reading. Amount column at 600 dpi in two half-page bands per page: pp.3-8 (12 crops) and pp.10-11 (3 crops). Date column at 600 dpi in two bands per page: pp.3-8 (12 crops). Donor-name column at 400 dpi: pp.4-8 (5 crops; p3 names were already re-read in the 300 dpi address-column crop). Recipient+Purpose+Date band at 400 dpi: pp.10-11 (2 crops). Address column at 300 dpi on p3 (1 crop) to confirm the redaction bar leaves no geography. Every amount and every date on both sides re-read identically at the higher resolution; nothing changed.
